# Germany MCP — full catalog

Generated 2026-11-22T10:41:20Z. 31 read-only MCP servers (155 tools) for German web services. Every server runs locally with uvx, no API key, no account.

## bundesliga-mcp

Bundesliga, 2./3. Liga, DFB-Pokal & DEL via OpenLigaDB (free API, no key): fixtures, live scores, tables, top scorers.

- Category: sports
- Repository: https://github.com/mohammad-abbasi-sh/bundesliga-mcp
- PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/bundesliga-mcp/
- Install: `claude mcp add --transport stdio --scope user bundesliga -- uvx bundesliga-mcp`
- Tools (6):

  - `bundesliga_list_leagues`: Leagues with their current season
  - `bundesliga_get_fixtures`: One matchday's fixtures and results
  - `bundesliga_get_live_scores`: Current matchday scores and status
  - `bundesliga_get_table`: League table
  - `bundesliga_get_top_scorers`: Top scorers of a season
  - `bundesliga_get_match_detail`: Full detail of one match

## mediathek-mcp

ARD, ZDF, 3sat, ARTE, Phoenix & more via MediathekViewWeb (free API, no key): search programmes, latest broadcasts, by channel/topic, programme detail.

- Category: media
- Repository: https://github.com/mohammad-abbasi-sh/mediathek-mcp
- PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/mediathek-mcp/
- Install: `claude mcp add --transport stdio --scope user mediathek -- uvx mediathek-mcp`
- Tools (6):

  - `mediathek_search_programmes`: Search programmes by title, topic or description
  - `mediathek_latest_broadcasts`: Newest programmes across all channels
  - `mediathek_by_channel`: Newest programmes of one channel
  - `mediathek_by_topic`: All episodes of one show or series
  - `mediathek_programme_detail`: Full detail of one programme (video URLs, subtitles)
  - `mediathek_list_channels`: Channels in the film list

## dwd-mcp

DWD (Deutscher Wetterdienst) via Open-Meteo ICON model (no key): forecasts, current weather, official warnings & pollen.

- Category: weather
- Repository: https://github.com/mohammad-abbasi-sh/dwd-mcp
- PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/dwd-mcp/
- Install: `claude mcp add --transport stdio --scope user dwd -- uvx dwd-mcp`
- Tools (5):

  - `dwd_forecast`: ICON-model forecast for a German place (hourly + daily)
  - `dwd_current_weather`: Current conditions for a German place
  - `dwd_warnings`: Official DWD severe-weather warnings, filterable by state
  - `dwd_pollen`: Pollen counts for a German place (CAMS via Open-Meteo)
  - `dwd_find_place`: Find German places (name → coordinates)

  - `ecb_money_supply`: Euro-area money supply (M1, M2, M3)
  - `ecb_bond_yields`: Euro-area government bond yields by maturity

## uba-mcp

UBA (Umweltbundesamt) Air Data API v4 (no key): hourly air-quality measurements from 400+ German stations, pollutants, LQI classes & networks.

- Category: health
- Repository: https://github.com/mohammad-abbasi-sh/uba-mcp
- PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/uba-mcp/
- Install: `claude mcp add --transport stdio --scope user uba -- uvx uba-mcp`
- Tools (6):

  - `uba_list_stations`: Measuring stations, filterable by city, state, type, area or name
  - `uba_station_detail`: One station: address, coordinates, type, data window, recent pollutants
  - `uba_current_air_quality`: Latest hourly values + LQI at a station (code, id or city name)
  - `uba_measurements`: Hourly values over a date range (max 31 days) + min/max/mean & daily means
  - `uba_list_components`: All 12 pollutants: code, symbol, unit, name
  - `uba_list_networks`: The 17 measuring networks (16 Länder + UBA)

## openplz-mcp

OpenPLZ API (no key): German postal codes — localities, streets, municipalities, districts & the 16 federal states.

- Category: open-data
- Repository: https://github.com/mohammad-abbasi-sh/openplz-mcp
- PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/openplz-mcp/
- Install: `claude mcp add --transport stdio --scope user openplz -- uvx openplz-mcp`
- Tools (6):

  - `openplz_lookup_postal_code`: Which locality (or localities) a postal code belongs to
  - `openplz_search_locality`: Search localities by name, optionally within one postal code
  - `openplz_search_street`: Search streets by name, postal code and/or locality
  - `openplz_full_text_search`: Free-form street search across name, postal code and city
  - `openplz_list_federal_states`: All 16 federal states with key + capital
  - `openplz_admin_children`: One step down the administrative tree (state → district → municipality)

## feiertage-mcp

Feiertage — German public holidays via feiertage-api.de (free API, no key): holidays by year & state, is-it-a-holiday, next holiday & date ranges.

- Category: open-data
- Repository: https://github.com/mohammad-abbasi-sh/feiertage-mcp
- PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/feiertage-mcp/
- Install: `claude mcp add --transport stdio --scope user feiertage -- uvx feiertage-mcp`
- Tools (5):

  - `feiertage_list_holidays`: Public holidays of one year in one federal state (optional month filter)
  - `feiertage_is_holiday`: Is a date a public holiday in one state?
  - `feiertage_next_holiday`: The next public holiday on or after a date
  - `feiertage_holidays_between`: Public holidays in a date range (max ~2 years)
  - `feiertage_list_states`: All 16 federal states + NATIONAL (nationwide holidays)

Bundesregierung — the German federal government's official site (no key): latest press releases, articles, speeches & press conferences, keyword search & full document text (incl. official English translations).

- Category: news
- Repository: https://github.com/mohammad-abbasi-sh/bundesregierung-mcp
- PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/bundesregierung-mcp/
- Install: `claude mcp add --transport stdio --scope user bundesregierung -- uvx bundesregierung-mcp`

  - `breg_press_releases`: Latest press releases of the German federal government, newest first
  - `breg_articles`: Latest articles / Meldungen from bundesregierung.de, newest first
  - `breg_speeches`: Latest speeches, press statements & press conferences (mostly full transcripts)
  - `breg_search`: Search bundesregierung.de by keyword across the whole site

  - `breg_health`: Reachability probe of the press-releases listing
